title: Spider — E-Commerce Integration Hub
subtitle: Multi-Marketplace Orchestrator & Bling ERP (High Volume)
summary: Centralized PHP/Laravel hub to unify orders across Mercado Livre, B2W, Via Varejo, and Bling ERP. Redis asynchronous queue workers and MongoDB single source of truth.
overview: Spider is a high-throughput integration hub engineered to centralize order flows, product catalogs, inventory, and pricing across major national marketplaces (Mercado Livre, B2W, Via Varejo) and Bling ERP systems.
roleDescription: Lead Software Architect and Principal Backend Developer.
responsibilities: End-to-end hub architecture in PHP/Laravel with distributed processing using Redis/Laravel Horizon queue workers.
Designed NoSQL MongoDB repository for flexible schema storage of heterogeneous orders from multiple marketplaces.
Implemented reactive webhooks and real-time synchronization routines to eliminate overselling.
Structured reproducible Docker environment and AWS S3 asset storage.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Overselling and data inconsistency during simultaneous flash-sale traffic spikes across multiple marketplaces.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented distributed Redis locks, strict queue job ordering, and atomic inventory sync.
